_about: the fallback, tried when a string is not found under its own context — so a word
shared by several widget classes is written once.
A missing entry is NOT an error: JsonTranslator returns the English source for
it, so a partial catalogue is fully usable and a translation can land string by
string. (It must NOT return "": Qt accepts an empty string as the translation,
which would render the label blank.)
Coverage today: the menu bar and the status bar (the always-visible chrome).
Panel field labels, dialogs and log messages are still English — see
GUI_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md for what remains. Extract the current string set with
which also reports which wrapped strings this file is missing.
